scope: One user-specified condition, no parameter search. Original SF01 range-qualified 4h/2R/24h long-only, fixed10k notional. Not the live ladder.
condition: AND: latest completed15m RSI14<52 AND latest completed4h close/EMA200-1 >6%. Not EMA slope, raw EMA level, or live price against EMA. Both publication clocks respected.
entry: At original signal decision, B/C skip that signal when condition true; no delayed retry. Identical absolute TP/SL, sizing, original risk eligibility and ownership otherwise. Unknown during EMA warmup does not fire and leaves baseline intact; report missing coverage.
exit: C evaluates after entry at each newly available completed15m bar, using latest available4h. First true check requests market exit at decision+actionDelay. A/B keep original protection/24h timeout. No reset of signal, no re-entry without a fresh original signal. Stop/TP before the scheduled exit remains effective. Existing engine failureAt supports scheduled market exits; report its poc_failure label as indicator exit.
timing: Inherit 60/120s source lag, 0/60s action delay, stop-first/target-first and fees/+5bps stress. Full/older/recent parent windows. Same-day open inventory included. No future4h close used in15m checks.
seed: Use full accepted sealed candle tape from Dec5,2024. SMA-seeded EMA2004h requires200 complete bars; no synthetic prelaunch history. SF04 used Jan1,2026 seed, so check predicate agreement on its23 examples instead of claiming byte-identical EMA values.
reporting: Baseline adjacent W/L, win/loss dollars, average loss, net/DD, monthly deltas; sacrificed original winners, avoided losses, changed and replacement trades; original23-example condition counts. Full-screen inherited from parent. Thresholds selected after SF04 are development hypotheses, not out-of-sample validation.
excluded: No RSI/EMA threshold grid, HL additions, wider stop, ladder changes, new candles or live changes. No claimed saved-trade dollars without changed-path replay.
